scope: One ordinary public UI loss/restart loop; separate offline replay audit
resourceAssessment: Raw run retained its final resource-guard assertion. Six ERR_ABORTED events are kept separately, not reported as zero failed requests. All ten runtime files matched HTTP200/baseline hashes, and all current images were complete with nonzero naturalWidth at all seven captures. No missing image or game hard failure was observed. Cancellation during portrait DOM rebuild/reload is consistent with these observations, rather than proven for each individual event.
limits: One desktop Chromium route, not all loss causes or victory replay
No touch, physical device, audio, aesthetic, Safari or long-term storage validation
Other game and v1 save isolation inspected from the single-key source, not claimed as a personal-save UI test
